title: ColaPri: Class-Weighted Fair Queueing with a Per-Task Dispatch Bound for Cloud Task Scheduling (reproduction package)
description: Reproduction package for the ColaPri paper: a class-weighted fair task scheduler for cloud VMs (start-time fair queueing with a unit cost per task, applied per class) with a provable per-task dispatch bound, counter resynchronisation after idle periods and load-adaptive activation, implemented as a CloudletScheduler for CloudSim Plus 8.5.7. Includes the scheduler, eight baseline schedulers (FCFS, SJF, strict priority, priority with aging, an equal-share-per-class queue, CloudSim Plus's time-shared processor-sharing scheduler, DFPO as a weighted round-robin over three FIFO queues, and start-time fair queueing with ColaPri's own weights as the classical weighted-fair control), four task-to-VM mapping policies (Round-Robin, Min-Min, Max-Min, MCT), all eight experiment harnesses (EXP-A..H, including the aging-factor sweep, Poisson arrivals below capacity with an M/M/2 check of the engine, matched constant-weight controls for the activation study and the trace reduction without its length floor), a correction for a dispatch-order defect of CloudSim Plus 8.5.7 that let arriving cloudlets bypass the waiting queue of any space-shared scheduler (CloudletSchedulerFifo, with the EngineProbe that measures it), a per-task audit of the paper's waiting bound, the captured result logs behind every table in the paper, the figure-generation script, the bundled PlanetLab, Bitbrains and Materna trace subsets, and SHA-256 checksums plus provenance for the third-party traces that are not redistributed here (Alibaba, Azure). All simulated metrics are seed-deterministic and reproduce bit-identically. This work has been granted by the Ministerio de Ciencia, Innovación y Universidades (MICIU) AEI/10.13039/501100011033 under contract PID2023-146193OB-I00.
